query_text: Where can I find the latest news about the stock market?

action.query: latest stock market news Reuters markets
queries: latest stock market news Reuters markets
latest stock market news CNBC markets
latest stock market news MarketWatch markets

annotations.title: Stock indexes fall on AI angst while gold and silver rise with oil By Reuters

content.text:
Good places to find **latest stock market news**:

- **Reuters Markets** — fast, reliable global market news and concise daily market wraps. ([investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/shares-hesitant-after-us-jobs-data-oil-jumps-on-venezuela-blockade-4411720?utm_source=openai))  
- **CNBC Markets** — good for real-time headlines, TV clips, futures, earnings, Fed commentary, and analyst reactions.  
- **MarketWatch** — strong for U.S. market headlines, index moves, personal finance angles, and watchlists. ([morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/news/marketwatch?utm_source=openai))  
- **Bloomberg** — excellent professional-grade market coverage, but much of it is paywalled.  
- **Yahoo Finance** — convenient free quotes, charts, company news, earnings calendars, and portfolio tracking.  
- **The Wall Street Journal Markets** — high-quality reporting and analysis, usually behind a paywall.  
- **TradingView News / charts** — useful if you want headlines alongside technical charts.  
- **Your brokerage app** — Fidelity, Schwab, Robinhood, Interactive Brokers, etc. often aggregate Dow Jones, Reuters, or analyst notes.

For a simple setup, I’d use **CNBC or Yahoo Finance for quick headlines**, **Reuters for confirmation**, and **MarketWatch or Bloomberg for deeper context**.
